title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 At Aspect, we are one of London's largest property maintenance teams, covering more trades than anyone else and operating 24/7\. After more than 25 years of trusted service to thousands of residential and commercial customers, we are entering an exciting phase of rapid digital transformation. We are investing heavily in AI and automation to reimagine how we deliver customer service, field operations, and internal workflows.
 



 We are now looking for an experienced Generative AI Engineer to lead the charge in designing, building, and scaling the multi\-agent systems that will run at the core of our business.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 As our Generative AI Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of production\-grade agentic AI. This means going far beyond calling a model. You will build and maintain the agent harnesses that let large language models reason, use tools, and coordinate as multi\-agent systems, wrap them in the guardrails that keep them safe and reliable, drive real AI automation across the business, and stand up the observability needed to know exactly what those systems are doing in production.
 



 You will partner closely with stakeholders across Product, Design, and Operations to translate business needs into intelligent, scalable applications. This role is hands\-on and strategic. You will build solutions end\-to\-end while also helping shape the company's broader AI strategy.
 



 We are looking above all for someone who can design, orchestrate, and manage complex multi\-agent systems, and keep them dependable at scale.
 



  





**You Will** 




  




* Design, build, and manage production multi\-agent systems, including hierarchical agents, swarms, and complex coordination and hand\-off logic for multi\-tasking and automation.
* Build and maintain robust agent harnesses covering tool use, memory, planning loops, and orchestration, so agents run predictably and can be extended by the team.
* Implement guardrails across the stack, including input and output validation, policy enforcement, PII redaction, hallucination and safety checks, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for high\-risk actions.
* Design and deliver AI automation that removes manual effort across customer service, field operations, and internal workflows, tying agent actions to measurable business outcomes.
* Stand up AI observability from day one, including tracing, logging, evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, and alerting, so we can debug, measure, and continuously improve live systems.
* Develop and fine\-tune LLMs and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for specialised knowledge tasks.
* Integrate GenAI tools into platforms such as WordPress and Salesforce to enhance customer\-facing services.
* Work with multi\-modal models across text, vision, and voice to build versatile and conversational AI systems.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to identify high\-impact AI use cases, translate requirements, and deliver solutions that align with business goals.
* Mentor junior engineers, promote best practices, and contribute to AI architecture and strategic planning.
* Drive responsible AI development with a focus on fairness, security, and governance in compliance with ethical standards.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 




  




* 3\+ years in AI/ML, with at least 1 year focused on Generative AI and NLP.
* Proven experience designing and running multi\-agent systems in production, not just prototypes.
* Hands\-on experience building agent harnesses and orchestration logic with frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.
* Practical experience implementing guardrails and safety layers using tools such as Guardrails AI, NeMo Guardrails, or equivalent custom approaches.
* Experience with AI observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Helicone, or Weights and Biases.
* Strong programming skills in Python, proficient in libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
* Expertise in LLM architectures (OpenAI, Anthropic, LLaMA, Mistral, and similar) and RAG implementation.
* Familiarity with frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
* Experience with CI/CD for AI (GenAIOps), model monitoring, and cloud platforms such as Google Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker, or Azure AI.
* Knowledge of AI security, model explainability, and Responsible AI principles.
* Experience building or integrating voice\-enabled chatbots and multi\-modal systems.
* Hands\-on experience deploying AI services in WordPress or similar CMS environments.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management and project delivery experience across cross\-functional teams.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience working with open\-source AI tools and LLM.
* Background in AI ethics, fairness, compliance, or regulatory frameworks.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS), graph\-based reasoning, or knowledge graphs.
* Experience in property maintenance, home services, or customer service automation (not required, but a bonus).



  





**Location and Working Arrangement** 




  





 This is a full\-time, office\-based role at our London office. It is not a remote or hybrid position. We work closely as a team and want you in the office with us, collaborating in person with Product, Design, and Operations as we build these systems together.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  




* Be a key player in shaping the AI future of a rapidly growing company.
* Own the multi\-agent systems that will sit at the heart of how the business runs.
* Work in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment with autonomy and real impact.
* Work on cutting\-edge agentic AI, guardrails, automation, and observability from the ground up.
* Supportive team culture that values innovation, transparency, and personal growth.



  





 Apply now and help us bring intelligent systems to life at one of London's most recognised property service companies.

description:
**About the Role** 




 West Summit is a UK\-based systems and automation advisory. We help operations\-heavy SMBs (trades/field services, property agencies, professional services) and SAP\-running mid\-market firms eliminate manual backlogs. We deliver enterprise\-grade automation through our flagship product: the 3\-Week Operations Sprint—building sandboxed workflow pipelines (n8n, Python, Postgres, Docker, LLM APIs) with built\-in Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) exception queues.
 



 We are looking for a Software Engineer to build, test, and deploy these automation pipelines. You will take process maps and turn them into running sandboxes, connect APIs, write custom data\-extraction scripts, and build simple, reliable interfaces for client approvals.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Build Automation Pipelines: Construct and test workflows in n8n connecting email inboxes, document extraction services, vector databases, and client databases.
* Write Custom Scripting: Write optimized Python code blocks for PDF data parsing, text sanitization, API transformations, and LLM orchestration (OpenAI, Claude, and local vLLMs).
* Develop Custom Interfaces: Build lightweight, secure web dashboards (React, Retool, or custom modules) to support Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) manual reviews for low\-confidence data extractions.
* Contribute to the Code Moat: Document and package reusable code blocks, API connectors, and n8n nodes into our internal repository to speed up future Sprint delivery.



  





**Who You Are** 



* Hands\-on Developer: 6\+ years of experience in backend development, systems integration, or software engineering.
* Tool\-Fluent: Demonstrable experience with Python, Typescript, n8n (or similar node\-based orchestrators like Make/Zapier), Docker, and PostgreSQL.
* Integrations Builder: Comfortable reading API documentation, handling rate limits, webhook subscriptions, and authentication (OAuth2, API Keys).
* Pragmatic Engineer: You write clean, readable code with robust error handling and structured logs. You build to solve real operational problems.



  





**Our Engineering Philosophy** 



* At West Summit, we believe that the best automation is invisible, sandboxed, and exceptionally reliable. We don't build standard "AI wrapper" apps. Instead, we solve hard integration problems—like piping LLM outputs safely into legacy ERPs or designing failsafe manual gates. We prioritize clean APIs, rate\-limiting, and robust data schemas that keep operations running smoothly.

 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

 As an AI agentic Engineer on the End User Services team, you will help build the next wave of automation in Docusign's IT operations. This role is a unique blend of AI tinkering and foundational IT automation. Your primary focus will be designing, building, and continuously evaluating AI agents and automation workflows that make our internal IT operations faster, more reliable, and easier for our employees to use. You don't need to be a senior architect to succeed here. We are looking for a curious, builder\-minded engineer who loves tweaking AI prompts, structuring agentic tools, and connecting enterprise platforms. We prioritize an “out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) first” approach \- leveraging native platform capabilities in tools like ServiceNow \- while stepping in to build custom integrations (like Python scripts or REST APIs) when needed. * Experience writing and troubleshooting code in Python (or a similar language) and working with REST APIs and webhooks
* Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, or agentic frameworks

**Preferred**
* Familiarity with building or testing multi\-agent frameworks
* Experience with IT service management or ticketing systems (like ServiceNow, Jira)

* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and basic DevOps/CI/CD practices

 Life at Docusign

 Key Competencies

 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

 Most AI developer tools operate without any knowledge of how software actually behaves in production. Dynatrace is in a unique position to change that.

You will own the path that telemetry from AI workloads takes into Dynatrace — from the moment an SDK emits a span in a customer's LLM application, through ingest, validation, and into the data model that powers our AI observability product.

description:

As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

 Location
   

  

 This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada or the US.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to help customers transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role and it is not a features team. It is a multi\-disciplined deployment unit operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers from warehouse floor to executive sponsor designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

 Vacancy Status
   

  

 This is an existing job vacancy.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own customer solutions end\-to\-end. Rapidly prototype, iterate, and deploy solutions in live operational environments where the stakes are real and the timeline is short.
* Deliver relentless customer value. Build trusted relationships from the IC level to the executive sponsor and become the technical face of our company in the room.
* Run multiple threads. Carry several customer engagements in parallel based on customer priorities and pod capacity. Set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when reality shifts, operate without close supervision, and own the outcome.
* Operate as a SEAL team. A small, tight, multi\-disciplinary unit with focus and urgency tasks are traded seamlessly to whoever is closest to the skills needed.
* Make the product better. Partner with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings into durable platform capabilities not one\-off scripts.
* Drive adoption and lead the change. Mentor customer operators and guide their teams through solution transitions, so the new way of working actually sticks.


 What we are looking for
   

  

* AI \& Agentic Development
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.
* Software Engineering
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.
* Data Engineering \& Platforms
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.
* Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus not a requirement
* 2 – 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical\-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How To Succeed In This Role**
* You measure your own success in business outcomes efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements not lines of code shipped.
* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
* You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders written, verbal, and in the room.
* You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours no waiting for perfect clarity.
* You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver without being told.
* Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
* You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
* Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric and you still ship.
* You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.

 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

You enjoy solving messy problems. You’re comfortable navigating both technical systems and human workflows. You’re highly detail\-oriented and naturally proactive. When something breaks, you investigate. When a workflow feels inefficient, you improve it. When you learn something useful, you look for ways to apply it elsewhere.

How to Translate Business Needs Into Working AI Solutions
You’ll become the bridge between operational teams and technical implementation. You’ll learn how to turn vague requests into clear workflows, practical automations, and deployable systems.


How to Measure Real AI Impact
You’ll help maintain a transformation dashboard tracking hours saved, efficiency gains, and operational improvements across AI initiatives. You’ll learn how successful companies evaluate AI beyond hype and headlines.


How to Improve and Troubleshoot AI Workflows

How to Navigate AI Governance and Data Risk
You’ll develop a practical understanding of data governance, permissions, privacy concerns, and organizational risk management around AI systems. You’ll learn why responsible implementation matters just as much as innovation.


How High\-Performance Teams Actually Use AI

description:

 BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. **Your Opportunity**
 We are looking for an exceptionally skilled, hands\-on, and innovation\-minded AI Scientist \& Engineer to bridge the gap between advanced data science, experimental machine learning, and scalable enterprise software engineering in our new Assurance Innovation Lab. You will be working with our high\-performing innovation team, dedicated SMEs from our assurance practice and highly skilled professionals from our AI Studio, nationwide.
   

  

 This hybrid role is responsible for extracting high\-value insights from complex datasets, training custom large language models (LLMs), and designing, building, and deploying production\-grade agentic workflows and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions. Operating under enterprise governance frameworks like ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), you will deliver responsible, scalable, and highly impactful AI systems that drive true business transformation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this net new role will have 3–5 years of hands\-on experience building, fine\-tuning, deploying, and monitoring machine learning models and Generative AI solutions in an enterprise production environment. This role rests on the ability to work cross\-functionally with AI Architects, AI Studio Leads, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Full Stack Developers, and citizen developers on firm\-wide strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Collect, clean, and transform large, complex datasets for analysis.
* Build custom machine learning models and natural language processing systems using state\-of\-the\-art techniques.
* Leverage tools like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Nvidia Triton Servers to develop specialized large language models tailored to business needs.
* Train, evaluate, and optimize models for accuracy, explain\-ability, and ethical alignment.
* Clearly communicate technical analysis and results to stakeholders using data visualizations, reports, and presentations.
* Continuously monitor models and data pipelines in production to ensure quality and reliability.
* Stay up to date on the latest advancements in deep learning, NLP, reinforcement learning, and other AI methods.
* Understand our Assurance practice end\-to\-end, and the current and future needs of our Assurance practitioners

* You identify, recommend, and are focused on effective service delivery to your clients
* You share in an inclusive and engaging work environment that develops, retains \& attracts talent
* You actively participate in the adoption of digital tools and strategies to drive an innovative workplace
* You grow your expertise through learning and professional development.

* Data Science \& Deep Learning: Comprehensive experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.

* Data \& Vector Infrastructure: Hands\-on experience with Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, and standard SQL/NoSQL databases.
* DevOps / MLOps: Advanced proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, Nvidia Triton Inference Server, and MLOps tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights \& Biases).
* Cloud Platforms: Strong working knowledge of enterprise cloud environments including Microsoft Azure (Azure AI / AI Foundry), AWS (Bedrock), or GCP.
* Architecture \& Patterns: Demonstrated mastery of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and multi\-Agent AI design patterns.


**Ideal Candidate Will Have:**
* A systematic approach to problem\-solving and devising practical solutions for complex enterprise bottlenecks.
* Published academic research in top\-tier ML/AI conferences/journals OR demonstrated practical excellence through Kaggle competitions.
* High passion for translating complex data and multi\-agent system capabilities into tangible, actionable business value.


*The expected range of compensation for this role is $98,000 to $128,000 annually.*

 We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. description:

**Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.**
 Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high\-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.
   

  

 Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.
   

  

 For more information visit cultureamp.com.
   

  

**How you can help make a better world of work**
 Shipping an AI product is only the beginning. The harder challenge, one few teams have mastered is continuous production evaluation: diagnosing performance shifts in real\-time, decoding 'why' they occur, and driving measurable quality improvements at scale. We are looking for a Staff level Applied AI Scientist with a strong AI Engineering background to solve this problem for our Coach AI system, establishing the observability and evaluation frameworks that turn early production releases into robust, high\-performance production products and then to make this sustainable by enabling the rest of our engineering org to do the same.
   

  

 As part of this team of amazing humans,
   

  

*You will*
* Own the end\-to\-end feedback loop: establish a rigorous cycle of prompt engineering, evaluation at scale, and continuous improvement. You will build LLM\-powered analysis tools that diagnose performance shifts, provide deep\-dive insights, and automate recommendations for prompt or system\-level enhancements.
* Contribute to Context engineering: design and optimise what actually enters the model's context: retrieval, memory across sessions, context assembly and compression, and managing context budget in long or multi\-turn agentic flows. Validate each change against eval rather than opinion or adhoc testing.
* Design and run evals: sampling, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and labelling systems over de\-identified production traces (for example, with Langfuse) to build longitudinal evaluation monitoring and alerting.
* Eval\-driven agentic orchestration: contribute to the agent architecture (planning, tool use, routing, decomposition, verification/critique steps) and let eval findings drive structural changes — e.g. when a failure mode surfaces, add a self\-check step, change tool selection, or re\-route.
* Model and provider selection: make and own model/routing decisions against quality, latency and cost trade\-offs, including when to prompt vs fine\-tune vs swap models.
* Create and Monitor guardrails and safety in production: given sensitive coaching and people data, design input/output guardrails, PII handling, content\-safety and jailbreak resistance as part of the system.
* Enable others: through reusable frameworks, tooling and documentation so product and engineering teams run their own evaluations. Lead from the front, then hand over.
* Partner closely: with the AI Coach team, product, data science and people science so measured quality maps to real customer value.
* Stay current: with the latest evaluation, observability and LLMOps research and provider offerings.


*You have*
* Experience building and turning production agentic systems, including context engineering, RAG, memory, cost, model selection and performance.
* Proven experience analysing the performance of AI or data products in production and turning it into changes that maintained and improved the product.
* Hands\-on LLM evaluation in production: LLM\-as\-judge, eval datasets, human\-in\-the\-loop labelling, scoring against thresholds.
* Experience with Observability tooling for LLM and agentic systems (traces, sampling, prompt management, production monitoring such as Langfuse or comparable).
* Experience with longitudinal measurement: metrics and baselines, regression detection, quality tracking over time.
* AI\-native daily practice, comfortable using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) on multi\-step tasks, with clear judgment on when to direct an agent versus write code yourself.
* Strong technical writing and communication, and a track record of building capability into systems and teaching others to own it.
* Strong signals: built or scaled an eval and observability practice across multiple teams; evolved existing enterprise codebases with AI; production agentic systems (orchestration, RAG); a postgraduate degree in ML, CS, Applied Maths or related; public writing, talks or open\-source work in eval, observability or LLMOps.


*You are*
* Motivated by the effective scaling of AI system performance and adoption in production with the humility to learn in public and the resilience to be a self\-starter.
* Motivated by enablement. Your biggest wins come from teaching others and building this into our systems, which can mean you do not own what you build forever.


**The way we build at Culture Amp**
 At Culture Amp, our engineers are increasingly orchestrating agents that write code, rather than just writing it directly themselves. We guide, plan, build, and review loops where AI takes the initiative on routine work, allowing you to steer architecture, trade\-offs, and quality. We're investing in a shared "harness" of tooling and standards so agents can do real product work safely, and we all embrace these capabilities as a core part of how we ship.
   

  

 Please note: candidates must be legally authorised to work in the Australia for the duration of employment, the role is based out of our Melbourne or Sydney hubs.
   

  

**Perks \& Benefits**
 At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:
   

  

* Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long\-term success
* Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow
* Quarterly refresh days, an extended end\-of\-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle
* Inclusive parental leave from day one
* A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility
* Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you
* Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US \& UK only)


 Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.
   

  

 Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.
   

  

**Accommodations \& Data Privacy**
 If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
   

  

 Culture Amp will retain your CV \& personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion. Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period. For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

 AI Tooling \& Integration

* Hands\-on experience integrating LLM APIs into production applications, including familiarity with prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool use / function calling


 Leadership \& Collaboration

**Desirable Skills And Experience**
 Infrastructure \& Cloud

 AI \& Agentic Systems

 You've built AI systems that actually work \- not demos that fall apart under real conditions, but production\-grade solutions running on real enterprise data, under real security constraints, delivering real outcomes.  At Fusion5, you'll be the engineer who makes that difference for Australian enterprise clients. We're building out our AI practice and we need people who understand that the hard part of AI isn't the model \- it's the integration, the reliability, the governance, and the discipline to write code that doesn't collapse six months after you've moved on to the next engagement.
 



  





 This is a client\-facing role, which means you'll be close to the problem, not just the solution. You'll work inside delivery squads alongside architects and functional consultants, own the technical delivery end\-to\-end, and leave clients with something that genuinely improves how their organisation works.

 You'll design and build agentic AI solutions on Azure \- production\-grade systems using Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, RAG architectures, and multi\-agent orchestration \- integrated with the enterprise APIs, ERP systems, and data platforms clients actually run their business on.
 



  





 You'll write real code. Python and C\# for Azure Functions, FastAPI services, and the connective tissue that turns a capable AI model into a useful enterprise application.  Production AI systems for real enterprise clients \- not internal experiments or proof of concepts that go nowhere.

 Work at the cutting edge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot, and the full Microsoft AI stack with direct access to Microsoft resources.

 Tight delivery squads where your technical decisions actually matter \- not a large team where your work disappears into the machine.

 Clear progression toward Principal Engineer and Solution Architect roles as the AI practice scales.

 Certification support, conference access, and time to experiment. We need you to stay current and we support you in doing it.



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Australian enterprises are making real decisions about AI right now \- not planning to, not experimenting in isolation, but committing investment and staking business outcomes on it. The difference between those initiatives succeeding and failing often comes down to the quality of the engineering underneath them.
 



  





 Fusion5's AI practice exists to be the partner that gets this right. The Senior AI Engineer \- Azure AI Foundry is the technical backbone of that delivery.  Join Fusion5 and help shape the future of enterprise AI across Australia

 As an AI Engineer / Data Scientist on our team, you will design, build and evaluate production agentic AI systems, LLM applications that reason, call tools, retrieve knowledge and complete multi\-step tasks on behalf of our practitioners and clients. You will own problems end to end: from framing the approach and prototyping, to shipping reliable, observable agents at scale in the Azure cloud.
   

  

 We are a data science team at heart, so we care deeply about rigour: measuring agent quality, running evaluations, and using the scientific method to know whether something actually works, not just whether it demos well.
   

  

**Why PwC?**
 At PwC Australia, your skills meet purpose. We tackle big challenges across industries like finance, technology, energy, and health —giving you the chance to make a real impact. Here, your growth is our priority. You’ll work with leading teams, explore new technologies, and unlock your full potential.
   

  

 Join a global community of more than 370,000 people who value bold ideas, collaboration, and lasting change. Together, we’re building trust and shaping the future.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Building agentic solutions: agents that plan and execute multi\-step tasks over long horizons, with context compaction and tool\-call repair so they stay reliable and on\-budget.
* Designing and expanding agent tool ecosystems: file/document operations, sandboxed code and bash execution, web search, and enterprise integrations (e.g. MS Graph) — with well\-typed, testable schemas.
* Orchestrating multi\-agent / sub\-agent systems that spawn parallel sub\-tasks, coordinate, and report results back to a lead agent.
* Building stateful LLM workflows (e.g. LangGraph) for domain pipelines such as research, summarisation and report generation.
* Engineering RAG and retrieval pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search (pgvector / Azure AI Search), hybrid and re\-ranked retrieval, and grounding LLM outputs in trusted sources.
* Producing structured, reliable LLM outputs (function calling / Pydantic) and designing robust prompts and agent skills.
* Building evaluation harnesses and offline batch evals (including deep\-research style runs) to measure accuracy, faithfulness, cost and latency — and using those signals to iterate.
* Instrumenting agents with observability and tracing (e.g. Langfuse, OpenTelemetry) and tracking token usage and cost in production.
* Routing across multiple models and providers via an enterprise gateway (e.g. LiteLLM) and tuning model selection for quality, latency and cost.
* Producing clean, maintainable, efficient code deployed at scale in the Azure cloud; scaffolding new projects, pairing with engineers, and reviewing pull requests.
* Contributing to team stand\-ups and the broader software development lifecycle, and participating in firmwide data science, ML and AI forums.
* Coaching and mentoring junior data scientists and engineers.


**What we’re looking for:** 
 Applicants must be able to demonstrate the following key capabilities. We do not expect every candidate to tick every box, strong fundamentals and a track record of shipping LLM\-powered products matter most.
   

  

**Core skills:**
* Strong Python development experience, with hands\-on use of modern LLM frameworks and SDKs (e.g. OpenAI / Anthropic SDKs, LiteLLM, LangGraph).
* Deep, practical knowledge of prompt engineering, LLM workflows and agentic patterns, tool/function calling, multi\-step agents, and structured outputs.
* Experience building and optimising RAG pipelines, including evaluation, with industry\-standard tooling.
* Working knowledge of vector databases such as pgVector and Azure AI Search, plus embeddings and hybrid/semantic search.
* Strong experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL (or equivalents).
* A scientific, evaluation\-first mindset: selecting appropriate methods, applying algorithms at scale, and using the scientific method to derive robust, defensible conclusions about model and agent behaviour.
* Strong critical thinking, analytical rigour and outstanding attention to detail.
* Proper source code management and confident use of Git.
* Good written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively with remote teams.
* A proactive, problem\-solving approach and the ability to solve complex problems as part of a team.


**Desirable skills:**
* Experience with LLM observability and cost/quality tracing (e.g. Langfuse, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience routing across multiple models/providers (e.g. via LiteLLM or an enterprise gateway) and reasoning about model selection trade\-offs.
* Experience designing multi\-agent / sub\-agent systems and agent tool ecosystems (web search, file/document tools, enterprise integrations such as MS Graph).
* Experience with computer\-use / browser\-automation agents (e.g. Playwright).
* Knowledge of classical ML (regression/boosting) and deep learning (CNN/RNN), preferably in NLP or CV.
* A research background in ML/LLM model development, and the ability to identify emerging techniques and apply them to practical situations.
* Experience with microservices, containerisation (Docker), and building/operating data pipelines at scale.
* Experience with message\-queueing solutions (e.g. RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* Experience developing on cloud environments, particularly Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Blob, Key Vault, App Insights).
* Knowledge of agile software development lifecycles (SDLC) and experience on agile projects.
* TypeScript / full\-stack experience is a strong bonus: much of our agent tooling and UI is built in TypeScript (Vercel AI SDK, NestJS, Next.js / React), and being able to work across the Python and TypeScript stack is highly valued.


**What you’ll gain:**
* The opportunity to work with leading organisations and cutting\-edge technology that challenge and expand your expertise.
* Work within an inclusive environment committed to Inclusion and Diversity and First Nations Prosperity, ensuring diverse perspectives are at the forefront of our work.
* Flexibility means trusting you to choose when, where, and how you work balancing what’s best for you, your team, and your clients to grow and thrive together.
* Clear paths for career progression supported by continuous learning and leadership development.
* Generous leave entitlements to support your work\-life balance \- including floating public holidays, birthday leave and ability to purchase additional leave on top of your four weeks.
* A world\-class parental leave policy offering up to 26 weeks of leave for caregivers, supporting your family and personal life.

Slater and Gordon Lawyers are a leading personal injury and class actions law firm where every member of our team has a shared passion for our clients: we are people caring for people.


Our commitment to our people includes offering genuine work\-life balance, with a hybrid work environment allowing them to split their time between home and the office. We recognise and reward high performance and have outstanding employee benefits including a week of shutdown leave, paid parental leave, extra\-long service leave, together with various ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.

**What are we looking for?**



As a Cloud DevOps Engineer (AI), you'll play a key role in designing, building and operating secure, scalable cloud platforms that enable innovative AI solutions across the firm. Working within our AI \& Digital Enablement team, you'll collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists and technology leaders to transform experimentation into reliable production platforms. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of AI adoption while ensuring strong security, governance and operational excellence.

* Design, build and maintain Azure cloud platforms that support AI solutions and data products.
* Develop infrastructure as code using Terraform and/or Bicep with reusable modules and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate cloud infrastructure and operational processes using PowerShell and Python.
* Implement security, governance and compliance controls through Azure Policy, templates and deployment guardrails.
* Support AI engineers and data scientists to package, deploy and manage AI applications, models and platform services.
* Manage Azure services including App Service, Container Apps, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, API Management, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search and Storage.
* Design and maintain secure networking solutions including hub\-and\-spoke architecture, private endpoints, DNS and web application firewalls.
* Monitor platform performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, driving continuous improvement and root cause analysis.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, networking, deployment and access issues while working collaboratively with internal teams and external vendors.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the firm's AI platform, continuously improving automation, platform capabilities and DevOps practices.

**What will you bring?**


* 3\-5\+ years' experience in Cloud, DevOps or Platform Engineering, with strong experience in Microsoft Azure.
* Proven experience delivering Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or Bicep.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell and Python.
* Experience administering Azure networking, identity management and core Azure platform services.
* Knowledge of cloud security, governance and compliance best practices, including Microsoft Entra ID.
* Experience supporting AI, machine learning or data platforms, including MLOps or AI deployment pipelines.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills across cloud infrastructure and networking environments.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional agile teams.
* Microsoft Azure certifications, experience in professional services or exposure to containerisation technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes will be highly regarded.


**What next?**



If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply directly to Slater and Gordon. We prefer to talk with you personally and are not accepting applications from recruitment agencies.

**To be eligible for this position, you must be an Australian citizen, a permanent resident, or hold a valid visa with full and unrestricted working rights in Australia. Proof of work rights will be required as part of the Slater and Gordon application process.**

***Acknowledgement of Country*** Slater and Gordon acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea and community. We pay our respect to their elders past and present and extend that respect to all First Nations peoples today.

***Diversity \+ Inclusion*** Slater and Gordon is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that values diversity and ensures equal opportunities for all. Slater and Gordon is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other legally protected attributes. We understand that everyone has different needs. If you require reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process, please let us know in your application.

Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open\-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
 



 Future Secure AI (FSAI) is a leading enterprise AI company that was created in deep partnership with one of the world's largest financial institutions. Operating as an enterprise company with deep relationships at C\-suite with large global enterprises, FSAI believes humans and AI Workers will collaborate seamlessly to raise organisational performance. FSAI has dozens of partnerships with leading companies in most industries and regions globally.
 



 FSAI has a strategic focus on expanding globally as we continue our extraordinary journey to transform the world with the most cutting\-edge artificial intelligence
 



 We're hiring a Principal Software Engineer (AI) to help set the technical direction of our products and platform. You'll provide technical leadership across squads, projects, and product, shaping architectural decisions and working closely with engineering and customer delivery teams. If you do your best work when the problem is ambiguous and the stakes are high, you'll fit here.

* Designing human\-in\-the\-loop systems that keep humans in control of AI Co\-Workers operating in mission\-critical environments.

* Ensuring our platform remains model\-agnostic, integrating LLMs and AI frameworks from both established and emerging vendors.
* Working closely with customers to deeply understand their needs and make sure solutions exceed their expectations.


**Your application should demonstrate**
* 10\+ years of software development experience, with deep hands\-on AI work.
* Strong Coding fundamentals, we primarily use Node.js and typescript
* Experience with AI frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain or LangGraph.
* Experience building systems where security and data governance are first\-class design constraints, not afterthoughts.
* A track record of shaping and defending architectural decisions in complex, production environments.
* The communication skills to align technical and non\-technical stakeholders around hard trade\-offs.
* Sharp problem\-solving instincts and the follow\-through to match.


 Why join us
 
 You'll have genuine influence over the technical direction of a fast\-growing AI product company, technical leadership across the full breadth of our product, and a direct line into senior leadership.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About Elita** 




  





 Elita is the world's first longevity platform for pets, powered by biology. Think Function Health meets Flo meets Oura ring, for pets. We combine biological data, clinical histories, and owner\-captured observations to drive preventative care, earlier risk detection to result in more good years with the animals people love most.
 



  





 We're an early\-stage, growing fast, and backed by Side Stage Ventures, Archangel, M8 Ventures, Startmate, and XA Network.
 



  





 Our team is in the office 5 days a week in our beautiful Brunswick space, with easy access to pat beautiful dogs while you work.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 This is our first in\-house engineering hire so you're not slotting into a machine, you're helping build it.
 



  





 We’re looking for a Mid level Full Stack Engineer based in Melbourne to work directly alongside one of the Founders on building and scaling the core product, plus the internal tooling and automations that keep the whole business moving.
 



 We’re looking for a generalist with Front end, Back end and Cloud skills that one day can drop into the code and debug what's actually going on and jump into GCP to scale our Cloud Systems the next.
 



  





 AI skills are a must have for this role, we’re already AI\-directed and automated, so being genuinely fluent with AI coding tools to push our tooling to it’s potential is key for us.
 



  





 We care more about architectural judgement than syntax. Tools can write most of the code; we need someone who knows how to structure systems, make good design calls, and understand
 *why* 
 things are built the way they are.
 



  





 The work splits across our core product and business\-ops: in\-house software, automations, internal tooling. It's varied and it'll evolve as we grow and scale our product and business.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Build and ship across Blueprint: full\-stack TypeScript, React (19 \+ Vite), and Node.js / NestJS.
* Direct AI coding tools to do the bulk of the build, and push them to their full potential.
* Drop into the code and debug what's actually happening when the output needs a human.
* Make the architectural calls: structure systems, weigh design decisions, own the why.
* Build internal tooling and automations that make the whole business run faster.
* Work across our monorepo (Nx, pnpm).
* Help direct and support our offshore dev team when needed, without it becoming a management gig.
* Deploy and scale on GCP (Docker VMs) as we grow.
* Pitch in on Python data\-science processing and Capacitor mobile (iOS/Android) where the work calls for it.
* Turn what works into repeatable patterns the rest of the team can build on.
* Help build the connective tissue between our business\-ops, product\-analytics, and logistics stacks .



  





**A Day in the Life** 




  





**9:00:** 
 In the office. CI's green, yesterday's automation ran clean, and there's one Blueprint bug worth chasing. You triage and pick your first thing.
 



**10:00:** 
 Sync with the founders on a product feature. You sketch the architecture together, agree on the shape, and start building.
 



**11:00:** 
 Build session. You're automating as much as possible, reviewing what gets produced, stepping in by hand where it matters.
 



**12:30:** 
 Lunch. You pat Edgar Allan Paw (non\-negotiable).
 



**1:30:** 
 An internal\-ops problem lands. You spec a small automation, wire it up, and delete an hour of someone's weekly busywork.
 



**2:30:** 
 You wire up event tracking on the feature you shipped, then pull up last week's funnel to see where users are dropping off. The data tells you what to build next.
 




**4:00:** 
 Architecture time. A decision now saves weeks later, so you think it through and write up the why.
 



**5:30:** 
 Queue tomorrow's build, push your branch, head out.
 



  





**You're Our Person If** 




  




* You've got a strong full\-stack background in our ecosystem: TypeScript, React (we're on React 19 \+ Vite), Node.js / NestJS, working in a monorepo (Nx, pnpm). Familiarity across the stack matters more than deep expertise in every single piece.
* You have worked in and enjoy the early stages of startups like ours with roughly 3\-5 years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer
* You've got sound architectural judgement and you know how to structure systems, make good design decisions, and can explain why.
* You're genuinely fluent with AI coding tools and obsessed with pushing them to their limits. This is core to the role, not a box to tick.
* You can drop into unfamiliar code and work out what's actually going on.
* You've got a bias to action and a "I can figure that out today" attitude over "someone else will have to do this."
* You're happy helping steer an offshore dev team without wanting it to become a management job.
* Melbourne\-based and up for being in the office. We're small and face\-to\-face genuinely matters here.



  





**Good to have (not must\-haves):** 




  




* Cloud deployment and infra experience. We're on GCP via Docker VMs, and experience scaling cloud systems is valuable. It's not a dedicated SRE role, but cloud/infra and architectural chops are absolutely valued.
* Python. We do a fair bit of data\-science processing work, mostly deployed in Python.
* Mobile via Capacitor (iOS/Android). That's what's currently in the app stores.



  





**Who This Suits** 




  





 A strong Mid\-level Engineer who wants more responsibility and ownership in their work in an exciting early stage company with a mission to help our pets live as long as possible.
 



  





 Capability and AI fluency matter to us more than title, and we'll land on the right level (and salary) based on what you bring.
 



  





 This is the first engineering seat in the company, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with one of our Founders which means real ownership and a genuine hand in how engineering gets done here.
 



  





 If you're leaving a bigger company, we get the appeal of less red tape and meetings and more impact, as long as you know \& are comfortable with how scrappy, hands\-on, and short on playbooks we are \- you'll write the playbooks here rather than follow them.
 



  





 We're Melbourne\-based and work in the office in Brunswick as the default setting.
 



  





 If you crave ownership and want in at the ground level on a product and a mission you actually care about, this is it.
 



  





**This Role Is NOT** 




  




* A management seat. You'll help direct the offshore team, but you're here to build.
* A dedicated SRE or infra\-only role. Cloud matters, but it's not the whole job.
* A Senior or Staff role, we’re not quite at that stage yet.
* A ticket\-taking role. You help direct the build, you don't wait to be told.
* For anyone who treats AI tooling as optional, or as a threat.
* A remote\-first, slow\-paced corporate meeting factor. In\-person and fast is the default.



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




  





**Salary** 
 \= Dependent on experience and in line with market for our stage, we'll land on the right number based on what you bring, with room to grow as we scale.
 



**Equity** 
 \= You'll own a part of Elita through our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP). As the company grows, so does the value of your shares.
 



**Growth** 
 \= Skills \& ownership you won't get in a traditional growth role or a corporate environment, you'll be across every part of a growing startup, from R\&D to operations, marketing, and beyond.
 



**Your Profile** 
 \= Build your own name while you build ours. We back our people to be visible, speaking, posting, sharing the work, so your profile grows as Elita does.
 



**The Dog Factor** 
 \= Help millions of pets live longer, healthier lives \& and 10x your YoY dog\-patting frequency.

title: Data Science Consultant
description:
Introduction
   

  

**Data Science Consultant**
 SymphonyAI Financial Services is a leading provider of advanced AI\-driven solutions for financial crime and compliance management. Our cutting\-edge technology leverages artificial intelligence to deliver actionable insights, enhance decision\-making, and drive operational efficiency.
   

  

 We are seeking a client\-facing Data Science Consultant with AI/ML expertise to design, build, and deploy data science solutions for financial services customers. You will translate complex business challenges into AI use cases, develop and operationalize models (including LLM/NLP, graph, supervised and unsupervised learning), and integrate them with SymphonyAI products and customer ecosystems. You will lead discovery, deliver PoCs and pilots, establish robust MLOps and model governance, and ensure successful adoption and outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
 Client engagement and solution design
   

  

* Lead discovery workshops to elicit requirements, define success metrics, and translate business problems into AI solutions and delivery plans.
* Provide innovation, leadership and influence in the design of client\-centric solutions that are aligned with the SymphonyAI’s product offering.
* Create SOW inputs, estimates, and technical approach for services engagements; support pre\-sales with demos, POVs, and solution narratives.
* Manage the client review and sign\-off process for the suite of functional documents and artefacts.
* Take overall responsibility for the documentation of functional artefacts.


 Model development and delivery
   

  

* Build and evaluate models for key financial services use cases (e.g., anti\-money laundering, fraud detection, alert triage, trading surveillance, credit risk, customer intelligence).
* Apply advanced techniques: NLP/LLMs (RAG, summarisation, extraction, classification), graph/network analytics, time series, anomaly detection, and ensemble methods.
* Implement explainability (e.g., SHAP, LIME), bias/fairness testing, performance monitoring, and model risk controls to meet regulatory and enterprise standards.
* Deliver high\-quality PoCs and pilots; productionise with engineering using robust MLOps practices (CI/CD, model registry, experiment tracking, feature management).


 Data engineering and integration
   

  

* Work with client and internal teams to profile, transform, and validate data; build performant pipelines using SQL/Spark and orchestration tools.
* Integrate AI services with SymphonyAI products and client systems via APIs, microservices, and event streams; optimize for scalability, latency, and cost.
* Implement retrieval components (e.g., vector databases) and prompt orchestration frameworks for LLM\-based solutions.


 Change management and enablement
   

  

* Plan and execute user acceptance testing, training, and knowledge transfer to drive adoption and embed AI in business workflows.
* Mentor customer and internal teams; contribute reusable assets (templates, prompts, pipelines, notebooks) to accelerate future engagements.
* Provide thought leadership by sharing best practices and feedback to product and R\&D for roadmap influence.


**Key Requirements**
* Expertise in industry standard modelling tools and methods
* Client\-facing experience is essential including delivering presentations and product demonstrations, running workshops and managing client's expectations.
* Experience of delivering complex business or technology solutions, from gathering requirements to designing solutions
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal and able to communicate confidently and effectively at any level of the organisation.
* Ability to grasp technical concepts and translate them into business solutions.
* Good working knowledge of SQL and experience with Databases such as Oracle, DB2, SQL Server and Postgres
* Good working knowledge of Python (Pandas, NumPy, and scikit\-learn) or similar.
* An understanding of compliance processes and workflows within the financial services industry advantageous
* Experience of software development lifecycle practices (preferably Agile).
* Good knowledge of IT systems, architectures and terminology.
* Strong interpersonal/leadership skills.
* Knowledge and exposure with Unix (Solaris, AIX, Linux, HP UX) is advantageous
* Advantageous to have knowledge of financial regulatory modules, ideally to include AML, KYC, FATCA, CRS, and related topics.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) required; Master’s or PhD preferred.
* Experience: 5\-10 years in data science/ML with at least 3 years in financial services domains (banking, payments, insurance, capital markets) and 2\+ years in client\-facing or professional services roles.


**About Us**
 SymphonyAI is building the leading enterprise AI SaaS company for digital transformation across the most critical and resilient growth industries, including retail, consumer packaged goods, financial crime prevention, manufacturing, media, and IT service management. Since its founding in 2017, SymphonyAI today serves 1600\+ Enterprise customers globally and has grown to 2,300 talented leaders, data scientists, and other professionals across over 30 countries.

title: Architect, Data and AI Engineering
description:
Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid\-market companies, and 500\+ public sector organisations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. 
 



  
 



**Architect \- Data and AI Engineering** 




 The purpose of our Data and AI practice at Slalom is to build a better future with Data. Through trusted partnerships with our clients, we co\-create modern data solutions that drive results and improve the world. We are continuing to grow our practice whilst keeping Diversity, Equity, and Inclusiveness at the forefront, and hiring individuals who share a similar passion for data, technology, and culture. 
 



  





**What You Will Do?** 




 ·    Work in small, collaborative teams with minimal oversight and direction to design and deliver innovative solutions on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform using core cloud data warehouse tools, distributed processing engines, event streaming platforms, and other modern data technologies. 
 



 ·    Build the next generation of data platforms and work with some of the most forward\-thinking organizations in data and analytics.
 



 ·    Responsible for understanding the client’s current environment and technical challenges as well as their plans for evolving or creating their future state architecture. 
 



 ·    Using your personal experiences, architecture expertise and your consultative skills, you will facilitate working design sessions with Slalom and Client technical teams to drive the strategy, architecture, and implementation of a data engineering solution. 
 



 ·    Effectively describe the pros and cons of your solution design and drive the combined Slalom and client team to a consensus. 
 



 ·    Breaking down complex development tasks and will be responsible for the timely quality completion of development items assigned to you and the development team reporting to you, ensuring that they support the Technical Solution you designed.
 



 ·    As time allows, you will participate in pre\-sales activities including helping define an approach to solving a prospect’s technical challenges and helping the business development team estimate and plan projects to address those challenges.
 



  





**What You Will Bring?** 




 • Broad experience in architecture design, a deep expertise in one or more data engineering technologies (listed below), a curious mindset to your client's engagement, a thirst for knowledge, and a hunger for fearless experimentation in new and interesting ways to meet our clients' most pressing data challenges.
 



 • Self\-starter mindset and ability to effectively break down large problems into smaller ones and regularly share your learnings within your projects and in the broader Slalom Build community.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with modern data platforms and programming languages across a range of technologies that we help our clients with including:
 


* Big Data \& Lakehouse Platforms (Databricks, Apache Spark, cloud\-native big data services on AWS and Azure)
* Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake)
* Cloud Data Warehouses (Databricks SQL, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse Analytics)
* Data Ingestion \& Integration (Fivetran, dbt, cloud\-native ETL/ELT services on AWS and Azure)
* Programming Languages (Python, Scala, Java, SQL)
* NoSQL Databases (AWS, Azure, and MongoDB offerings)
* Container Management (Kubernetes, cloud\-native container services on AWS and Azure)
* Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (Databricks ML, MLflow, cloud\-native ML services on AWS and Azure)
* Streaming \& Real\-Time Analytics (Databricks Structured Streaming, Apache Kafka, cloud\-native streaming services on AWS and Azure)
* Visual Analytics \& BI (Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, Databricks SQL Dashboards)
* Modern Data Workflows \& Orchestration (Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, dbt, cloud\-native orchestration on AWS and Azure)



  





  





**Our Values** 
  
 



 Our culture and values reflect each individual Slalomer. We are dedicated to encouraging workplace diversity and ensuring all our people, from any background can contribute to their full potential. We wish to build a team that echoes the diversity of the communities we serve, and our values are an active part of our every\-day, guiding our decisions. 
 



  





**What keeps us here?** 




 When we moved to Australia in 2020, we had no idea just how important our work/life balance would need to be. We’ve asked our consultants what makes Slalom a great place to work and the most common answer – “the freedom to be ourselves when life gets in the way”. We make a big effort to bring everyone together and allow space when space is needed. We believe in helping each other thrive in work and life and are proud to invest in benefits that include holistic wellbeing, meaningful allowances, and investment in our team’s professional, technical, and personal growth. 
 



  





 Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Slalom does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion, or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

title: Lead, AI Engineering & SDLC Automation
description:
**Job Description**
 We’re looking for a
 **Lead, AI Engineering \& SDLC Automation** 
 (Director) to define and lead PSD’s AI\-enabled engineering automation strategy, roadmap, and delivery function. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering AI\-assisted engineering capabilities, agentic workflow automation, and SDLC automation that meaningfully improve developer productivity and software delivery across the Productivity Solutions Division.
   

  

 You will own the selection, integration, governance, and adoption of AI\-enabled engineering tools and automation within developer workflows, partnering across DevSecOps, Developer Experience, Security, QE, IT, and engineering teams to scale safe, reliable, and measurable AI\-enabled software delivery practices.
   

  

**Impact**
 Your leadership will help PSD accelerate software delivery by embedding AI\-powered automation into the core of engineering workflows. You will improve developer productivity, reduce manual toil, increase consistency across the SDLC, and help teams adopt AI\-enabled practices safely, reliably, and at scale.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and develop the AI Engineering \& Automation team responsible for AI\-assisted SDLC automation, developer workflow integration, and engineering productivity tooling.
* Define team priorities, resource needs, operating cadence, performance expectations, and execution plans.
* Own the roadmap for AI\-enabled engineering automation across PSD, from tool selection and integration to adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Deliver AI\-assisted engineering tools, agentic workflows, copilots, and workflow automation with measurable productivity uplift.
* Integrate AI automation into CI/CD pipelines, developer paved roads, engineering workflows, and platform services.
* Establish governance, safety guardrails, evaluation criteria, usage standards, and secure integration patterns for responsible AI adoption in engineering workflows.
* Partner with DevSecOps, Developer Experience, Security, QE, IT, and engineering teams to embed automation into software delivery practices.
* Prioritize AI automation investments based on productivity uplift, developer experience, quality, reliability, security, cost, and platform strategy.

description:
**Come shape the future of commerce built for passion with us!** 




  





 At EQL, we’re building tools for brands that don’t just have customers—they have fans.
 



  





 These are the high\-stakes cultural moments where passion runs deep, but the experience has often been broken: sites crash, bots win, and real fans lose out. If you’ve ever tried to score Jordans, Taylor Swift tickets, or a footy final seat, you know the frustration. EQL is changing that. We’re creating the world’s first fair launch platform to help retailers manage demand, block bad actors, and deliver seamless experiences that give real fans a fair shot.
 



  





 Backed by top VCs and angels, we’re solving big, meaningful problems with smart tech and a bold, collaborative team. It’s challenging and rewarding work, and we’re building a culture where curious, kind, and ambitious people thrive. If you want to help us shape the future of fan\-first commerce—even if you don’t tick every box—we would love to talk.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 EQL is hiring a Head of Engineering to lead the next chapter of our platform. A major label drops limited merch to thousands of fans at once. The site holds, the queue stays fair, the right fans get through. EQL has largely figured that part out: the infrastructure is solid and the reliability is there.
 



  





 The next frontier is intelligence. Every launch generates a wealth of signal: who showed up, how they behaved, what they bought, what they missed. Most of it sits underused today. The opportunity is to turn EQL into a platform that genuinely learns from every drop, getting better at predicting what will sell, to whom, and when. That means building intelligence in, as a capability layer, not a feature: audience controls driven by real fan data, personalisation, demand forecasting that sharpens production calls before a drop goes live. We run the EQL platform and Shopify on the launch side and Fans as our audience layer, and connecting all three into one compounding system, where every launch makes the next one smarter, is the challenge we're asking this person to lead.
 



  





 We need someone who finds that exciting, who knows what best\-practice AI engineering looks like today and has the range to bring a team with them. The engineering team reports to you, but this isn't a role for managing from a distance. The best version of this person stays close to the architecture, and shapes the technical decisions that matter.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  





**Technical Vision \& Platform Direction** 



* Set the technical vision for EQL's platform: where it needs to get to, how it gets there, and what the architecture looks like when it does
* Make the consequential platform decisions (build vs buy, architectural trade\-offs, the integration points between EQL, Shopify, and Fans) and make sure the team builds confidently within them
* Be the technical counterweight in product and leadership conversations: clear\-eyed about what's possible, what's hard, and what the right trade\-off is
* Represent engineering at the leadership table with a point of view grounded in the work, not abstracted from it



  





**Building Intelligence Into the Platform** 



* Own the intelligence strategy: how recommendation, personalisation, demand forecasting, and audience controls are architected as a compounding layer, not a series of one\-off features
* Think seriously about what best\-practice AI engineering looks like for EQL: the data pipelines, feature stores, and inference infrastructure that make intelligence reliable in production, under real load
* Own the vision for how fan data becomes a strategic asset: what we capture, how we model it, and how it feeds back into better outcomes for brands and better experiences for fans
* Partner with product to find where intelligence creates the most leverage, then lead the architectural thinking on how EQL, Shopify, and Fans evolve from separate systems into one interconnected platform



  





**Leading the Engineering Function** 



* Lead and develop a team of 12 engineers across two Engineering Managers: setting direction, raising the bar, and building a culture where great work is the norm
* Be the kind of leader engineers want to work for: technically credible, direct, and genuinely invested in their growth
* Own hiring and team shape, building toward the capabilities EQL needs
* Work with the EMs on delivery and team health; they run the day\-to\-day, you set the context and standard
* Build an engineering culture that's AI\-native by default, where the team reaches for the best tools, moves fast, and ships things that matter



  





**Vendor Management \& Technology Decisions** 



* Accountable for the evaluation of and relationships with key technology vendors: AI tooling, ML infrastructure, data platforms, Shopify ecosystem partners
* Stay genuinely across what's happening in AI and ML engineering, not conference\-talk trends but the tools and techniques actually changing what's possible



  





**Who we look for** 




  





 We focus on hiring values\-aligned people because we believe mindset matters as much as experience. Curiosity, drive, and a willingness to learn go a long way. Working at EQL means embracing ambiguity, being okay with imperfection, and playing bigger than we are as we solve tough problems together. If that sounds like it gives you energy and are excited to grow with us, we encourage you to apply—even if you're feeling unsure.
 



  





**We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:** 




  




* Extensive experience in software engineering, with meaningful time in both senior IC and engineering leadership roles — you have done both and know the difference
* Been to the summit of what’s possible with AI in engineering, and can lead real technical change: platform evolution, AI adoption, significant architectural shifts
* Experience leading teams building AI/ML systems in production — recommendation engines, demand forecasting, personalisation, or consumer intelligence. Not just API integrations; the systems underneath
* Strong understanding of data engineering: pipelines, feature stores, event streams, and the architecture that makes machine learning reliable at scale
* Ecommerce or marketplace background is a strong plus — you understand the commerce context even if you have not specifically worked in the fan or creator space
* You use every tool available to you, including AI — to ship great work fast. What matters is the quality of your thinking and your architectural judgment, not how much of the code you typed yourself
* You lead through technical credibility — engineers follow your direction because they respect your judgment, not because of your title
* You can explain a complex technical trade\-off to a non\-technical leader without losing the substance of what makes it hard
* You are direct about what is hard, what is wrong, and what the right call is — even when that is uncomfortable
* You build strong engineering cultures — by setting a standard and inspiring through it
* You’re genuinely curious and get energy from hard problems. You have a strong sense of agency and move to solve the right problems with urgency



  





**What we offer** 




  





 Fairness is not just something for our fans and retailers \- it’s part of who we are which is why:
 


* We provide equity in EQL \- we want our team to have skin in the game and to be as invested as we are in EQL’s success. We want the people that will make EQL successful to share in that success
* We provide competitive compensation and evaluate the market to ensure that remains true.
* We provide a flexible work environment because we understand that everyone works differently and want to support our team to be their best
* We provide generous time off above and beyond what we are required to because we know that well\-rested people make better decisions and are more engaged \- when you thrive we thrive
* When you want to collaborate in person with other humans, we have a workplace that welcomes the whole team including their furry friends.



  





*At EQL, diversity, equity, and inclusion are core to how we operate and grow. We’re committed to building a workforce that values and supports every individual. We believe equality strengthens our culture and drives accountability in championing diverse voices. EQL is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital or caregiving status, pregnancy, religion, political beliefs, or national origin.*
